description: Removes one share of a library file by its grant id (from get_file). Needs admin access on the file. Org-visible files stay visible to every member; make it restricted with update_file to limit it to its shares. Free. Needs an API key or a connected account.

id.description: The file's id from list_files or save_file.

name: unshare_file
title: Stop sharing library file
